jobs.title: AI Research Intern, Summer 2026/2027 Australia
jobs.description: Join Atlassian's Machine Learning Research team focusing on Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Conversational Agents, and AI Optimisation. Collaborate with Research Scientists and ML Engineers to design, implement, and evaluate experiments advancing performance, efficiency, and scalability of ML and LLM systems. 12-week paid internship, November 2026–February 2027. Australian/NZ citizens and Permanent Residents only.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Intern, Summer 2026/2027 Australia
jobs.description: As a Machine Learning Engineer intern in Atlassian's Core ML Analytics group, you'll work on model development, evaluation, and productionisation, with experience in experimentation, feature engineering, and data pipelines. Python, Scala, or Spark required; SQL a plus. Master's preferred; 12-week full-time program November 2026–February 2027, graduating by January 2028.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern - ANZ
jobs.description: Machine Learning Engineers at Canva design, build, and maintain complex systems applying statistics and machine learning at scale, helping users discover 75M+ templates, photos, videos and elements, and improving user engagement. 12-week remote-friendly internship running from the last week of November to the last week of February. Full Australian or New Zealand working rights required.

jobs.title: 2027 NAB Graduate Program - Digital, Data and AI Sydney
jobs.description: The 2027 NAB Graduate Program commences 15 February 2027 with rotations across Design, Digital, Data Analytics, AI experimentation, and Ecom specialisations. You will apply analytics and modelling to solve business problems and support AI enablement. Hands-on experience with training, mentorship and networking. Australian/NZ citizenship or Permanent Residency required. Applications close 29 March 2026.

jobs.title: 2027 NAB Graduate Program - Digital, Data and AI Melbourne
jobs.description: The 2027 NAB Graduate Program commences 15 February 2027, Melbourne-based, with rotations across Design, Digital, Data Analytics, AI experimentation, and Ecom specialisations. You will apply analytics and modelling to solve business problems and support AI enablement. Hands-on experience with mentorship and networking across the NAB organisation. Applications close 29 March 2026.

jobs.title: 2027 CommBank Graduate Program: Technology - Data Science
jobs.description: 12–18 month Data Science & AI rotational program with an 8-week structured onboarding bootcamp. You'll build quantitative and predictive models, LLMs and chatbots, gaining exposure in Decision Science, AI, Gen AI & ML, and Data Engineering. Enhance technical capability using Python, AWS and Teradata. Sydney-based; minimum 65 WAM; Australian/NZ permanent resident or citizen required.

jobs.title: 2026 CommBank Data Science Graduate Program
jobs.description: Market-leading rotational Graduate program with 2–3 diverse experiences across Decision and Behavioural Science, Quantitative & Predictive Modelling, AI & machine learning, and Data Engineering. You'll strengthen technical skills with SQL, Python, AWS, and Teradata. 8-week structured onboarding bootcamp included. Final year or within 24 months of degree completion; minimum credit average required.

jobs.title: 2026 Optus Winter Internship Program
jobs.description: 3-month Optus Winter Internship commences July and concludes October 2026. You'll gain skills across technology and customer experience with placements in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, IT, and related disciplines. Includes curated workshops, an express lane into Optus's Graduate Program, and flexible working from Macquarie Park campus three days per week.

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist
jobs.description: As Lead Data Scientist in OneData you'll contribute to Wesfarmers' strategic data science direction, with GenAI as a core pillar. Responsibilities include leading a high-performing team, driving enterprise-wide AI adoption, and delivering transformational outcomes through deep technical expertise. Reporting to the Advanced Analytics Manager at Wesfarmers OneDigital, Melbourne.

jobs.title: 机器学习平台开发实习生
jobs.description: 负责机器学习训练平台研发，包括数据处理系统、模型训练系统和模型推理系统，建立从数据到模型到交付的端到端生产闭环。要求计算机科学或相关专业硕博在读，熟练掌握C/C++或Python，具备扎实的数据结构和基础算法能力。27届日常实习，base北京。

jobs.title: AI-Lab计算机视觉算法实习生
jobs.description: AI-Lab计算机视觉算法实习生，负责计算机视觉算法研究与实现及AI审核技术研发，识别短视频、直播和图片中的不当内容。要求计算机科学本科及以上学历，技术积累方向包括图像/视频分类、视频内容分析、文字检测识别、场景理解、人脸识别、目标跟踪、机器学习。有顶会论文者优先，具备较强的算法和编程能力。

jobs.title: 达摩院对话团队-研究型实习生
jobs.description: 达摩院对话团队专注于NLP和智能人机交互创新及大规模应用，研究方向包括多源异构知识融合的多轮对话模型、跨领域对话策略、基于对话上下文的语言理解（指代消歧、省略补全）及低资源NLP理解。要求NLP/机器学习/AI相关方向研究生，能全职实习3个月以上，熟练掌握Python/Java/C/C++，薪资400-500元/天。

jobs.title: 弹性计算实习生
jobs.description: 阿里云弹性计算团队招聘实习生（北京/杭州），岗位涵盖Java、Go、C/C++、Python等开发方向及数据库、大数据、网络、存储、高性能计算等基础平台开发。工作内容包括OS镜像研发与测试、实例启动优化、生产环境监控优化、智能调度系统开发及AI for Cloud探索。面向2026/2027届本科及以上学历学生。

jobs.title: 研究院研究实习生
jobs.description: 百度研究院招聘研究型实习生，研究方向包括多模态学习、计算机视觉、机器学习。要求计算机视觉/深度学习/机器学习方向硕士/博士在读，每周至少3天全职实习6个月以上，熟练掌握Python及深度学习框架，有在CVPR、ICCV、NeurIPS等顶会以第一作者发表论文经历者优先。base北京。

jobs.title: AI产品经理（Agent方向）
jobs.description: 负责规划、设计和迭代MiniMax Agent相关产品，理解用户需求，设计Agent场景、交互流程、功能机制及产品体验，与研发、算法、设计、运营团队协作推动高质量产品交付。要求1年以上产品经验，有AI/AIGC/工具/效率/创意产品经验者优先，对AI Agent有持续兴趣，具备强学习能力和高效沟通能力。上海，社招全职。

jobs.title: 搜索算法实习生 NLP/召回/排序相关
jobs.description: 搜索融合排序算法优化，负责搜索召回和排序阶段全链路优化，探索AI前沿技术应用，设计和优化短视频搜索相关性、权威性、点击率和播放时长预测模型。NLP方向利用快手海量短视频数据，通过NLP技术提升搜索核心场景效果和用户体验。要求机器学习/深度学习、NLP、数据挖掘扎实基础，hc充足，可转正。base北京。

jobs.title: 数据分析实习生
jobs.description: 腾讯People Analytics研究室数据分析实习生（深圳腾讯滨海大厦）。岗位职责：参与人力资源相关数据分析项目，进行研究设计和系统性数据分析，支持组织和人力相关洞察输出。要求硕士及以上学历，具备研究设计和系统性数据分析训练背景，统计学/心理学/管理学等相关专业，有量化研究经验者优先。

jobs.title: 淘系内容社交平台实习-算法
jobs.description: 阿里巴巴大淘系数据团队招聘算法实习生，专注于淘宝/天猫内容社交平台的算法研发，通过大数据和算法驱动业务增长。工作内容涵盖内容分发、社交推荐、用户行为分析等核心场景算法优化。面向2026/2027届应届生，北京/杭州，实习转正率高。
